name: new_horizons_land_taps_for_two_of_one_color
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Enchant land. When this Aura enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."' Seat 0 casts New Horizons on its Odd Desert (a land with no mana ability of its own); the enters trigger puts a +1/+1 counter on Your Bear. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The Desert's granted ability makes two blue, one colour chosen once, which pays Fog Bank's {1}{U} exactly: the Desert taps.
